reyda seddiki wrote:
>
> Hi !
> Vampire Watenda's Power seems incredible !
> but however...
> Can Watenda cancel a "Zip Gun" ?

Yes.

> Can Watenda cancel a "Psyche" ?

Inferior, yes.
Superior, no, since the superior is played after combat ("at the end of combat").

> If Watenda cancel a strike, can my opponent choose the same strike again
> ?

Yes.

> What about the blood paid for the canceled card ? I mean, I play Burning
> Wrath on Watenda, if he cancels it, can i have my 3 blood points back ?
> Are they lost forever ?

They are lost (but note: Watenda had to pay 3 blood to cancel it as well,
so you're even).

> By the way, when I use "Primal instinct" to cancel my own strike, is the
> blood from the previous strike retrieved ?

No.
